svg.title: multae-viae architecture
svg.desc: Two-crate architecture: the mv-cli binary (clap commands, model router, Rig agent loop, session memory) sits above the mv-core library (workflow engine, model registry, error taxonomy, tools, MCP client, TRT-LLM support, memory trait), joined by the PromptExecutor and ToolExecutor trait seam. Configuration files feed mv-core; the binary talks to model backends (Ollama, TensorRT-LLM proxy, OpenAI-compatible cloud) and MCP servers (stdio, HTTP with bearer auth, the klams memory service); spans export over OTLP to Jaeger.
svg.text: A local-first agentic controller: one binary that sees Rig, one library that doesn’t · YAML workflow DSL · OpenTelemetry throughout

g.text: process boundary · provider dispatch · the only crate that sees Rig
preflight skips dead locals · walks prefer / fallback chains · truthful errors
SYSTEM_PREAMBLE + merged tool set · multi-turn ≤ max_turns
mv-core sees only these traits — Rig and providers stay in the binary
all reusable logic — a future mv-server builds on this, unchanged
typed context — {{report.title}} · score >= 8 · outputs shadow inputs
from models.yaml — the first reachable model serves
fallback when local models are down
merge into the agent’s tool set — built-ins win collisions
failed servers are skipped, never fatal · output capped at 10k chars
gen_ai.* · router.* · workflow, model & tool spans, token usage
